name: US Brokerage Account Statement
description: US individual brokerage account statement (Schwab, Fidelity, Vanguard, Merrill, TD, IBKR and similar). Removes only client-identifying data: account holder names in capitals on registration lines, headers and footers, labeled client names in normal case, account numbers in labeled, partial and masked forms, SSN / tax ID (also masked), US phone numbers, state + ZIP in address blocks, plus mailing addresses and e-mails from the built-in detectors. The generic name detector and the generic account-number detector are switched off on purpose: they would treat security names (JOHNSON & JOHNSON, SCHWAB US DIVIDEND EQUITY ETF) as people and CUSIPs as account numbers. Amounts and license plates are off too, so figures stay readable. Keeps security names, tickers, CUSIPs, quantities, prices, market values, balances, income, fees, cost basis, gains/losses, statement dates and the custodian's name. The custodian's own phone number and ZIP code are covered: remove them with the X if you want them visible. Signatures and QR codes are not detected: draw a manual box over them.

patterns.name: Account holder name
patterns.description: Client and joint-holder names printed in capitals on registration lines, headers and footers (DANIEL R MORGAN & LAURA J MORGAN JT TEN). Security rows (name + symbol + CUSIP) and statement headings are excluded; if a capitalised security name is still caught, remove it with the X.

patterns.name: Client name
patterns.description: Client names written in normal case after a label (Account Holder:, Registration:, Prepared for, Dear Mr. ...)

patterns.name: Account number
patterns.description: Account number after an Account / Acct / A/C label, with optional letter prefix and dash (e.g. 1234-5678, X12-345678, U1234567)

patterns.name: Account number
patterns.description: Dash-separated account formats such as 1234-5678 or 123-456789 wherever they appear; phone numbers are left to the phone pattern

patterns.name: Masked account
patterns.description: Partially masked account or card numbers: ****1234, XXX-5678, ...4321

patterns.name: SSN
patterns.description: Social Security or taxpayer ID, including masked forms such as XXX-XX-1234

patterns.name: Phone
patterns.description: Client phone numbers; separators required so CUSIPs and account numbers are not matched

patterns.name: ZIP code
patterns.description: City line of an address block, e.g. FL 33101-1234 (two-letter state followed by ZIP)
